PSA 8:4: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
PSA 8:5: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
PSA 8:6: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
PSA 8:7: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
PSA 8:8: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
PSA 8:9: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
PSA 9:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
PSA 9:2: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
PSA 9:3: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
PSA 9:4: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
PSA 9:5: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.
PSA 9:6: The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.
PSA 9:7: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
PSA 9:8: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
PSA 9:9: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
PSA 9:10: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
PSA 9:11: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
PSA 9:12: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
PSA 9:13: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me! Lift me up from the gates of death,
PSA 9:14: that I may declare all Your praises—that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
PSA 9:15: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
PSA 9:16: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah
PSA 9:17: The wicked will return to Sheol—all the nations who forget God.
PSA 9:18: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.
PSA 9:19: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
PSA 9:20: Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah
PSA 10:1: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
PSA 10:2: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
PSA 10:3: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
PSA 10:4: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
PSA 10:5: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.
PSA 10:6: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”
PSA 10:7: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
PSA 10:8: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.
PSA 10:9: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
PSA 10:10: They are crushed and beaten down; the helpless fall prey to his strength.
PSA 10:11: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
PSA 10:12: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
PSA 10:13: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”
PSA 10:14: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
PSA 10:15: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
PSA 10:16: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
PSA 10:17: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
PSA 10:18: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.
PSA 11:1: For the choirmaster. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!
PSA 11:2: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
PSA 11:3: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”
PSA 11:4: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.
PSA 11:5: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
PSA 11:6: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.
PSA 11:7: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
PSA 12:1: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
PSA 12:2: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
PSA 12:3: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.
PSA 12:4: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips—who can be our master?”
PSA 12:5: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
PSA 12:6: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
PSA 12:7: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.
PSA 12:8: The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.
PSA 13:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
PSA 13:2: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?
PSA 13:3: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
PSA 13:4: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.
PSA 13:5: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
PSA 13:6: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.
PSA 14:1: For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
PSA 14:2: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
PSA 14:3: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
PSA 14:4: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
PSA 14:5: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.
PSA 14:6: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.
PSA 14:7: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
PSA 15:1: A Psalm of David. O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
PSA 15:2: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,
PSA 15:3: who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,
PSA 15:4: who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath,
PSA 15:5: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
PSA 16:1: A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
PSA 16:2: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
PSA 16:3: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
PSA 16:4: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
PSA 16:5: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
PSA 16:6: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
PSA 16:7: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
PSA 16:8: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
PSA 16:9: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
PSA 16:10: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
PSA 16:11: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
PSA 17:1: A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer—it comes from lips free of deceit.
PSA 17:2: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.
PSA 17:3: You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
PSA 17:4: As for the deeds of men—by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.
PSA 17:5: My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.
PSA 17:6: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
PSA 17:7: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
PSA 17:8: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
PSA 17:9: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
PSA 17:10: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
PSA 17:11: They have tracked us down, and now surround us; their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,
PSA 17:12: like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.
PSA 17:13: Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,
PSA 17:14: from such men, O LORD, by Your hand—from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.
PSA 17:15: As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
PSA 18:1: For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.
PSA 18:2: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
PSA 18:3: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
PSA 18:4: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
PSA 18:5: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
PSA 18:6: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
PSA 18:7: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
PSA 18:8: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
PSA 18:9: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
PSA 18:10: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
PSA 18:11: He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.
PSA 18:12: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced—hailstones and coals of fire.
PSA 18:13: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded—hailstones and coals of fire.
PSA 18:14: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
PSA 18:15: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
PSA 18:16: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
PSA 18:17: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
PSA 18:18: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
PSA 18:19: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
PSA 18:20: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
PSA 18:21: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
PSA 18:22: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
PSA 18:23: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
PSA 18:24: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
PSA 18:25: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
PSA 18:26: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
PSA 18:27: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
PSA 18:28: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
PSA 18:29: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
PSA 18:30: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
PSA 18:31: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
PSA 18:32: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
PSA 18:33: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
PSA 18:34: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
PSA 18:35: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
PSA 18:36: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
PSA 18:37: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
PSA 18:38: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
PSA 18:39: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
PSA 18:40: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.
PSA 18:41: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them—to the LORD, but He did not answer.
PSA 18:42: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
PSA 18:43: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
PSA 18:44: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
PSA 18:45: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
PSA 18:46: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
PSA 18:47: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,
PSA 18:48: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
PSA 18:49: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
PSA 18:50: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
PSA 19:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
PSA 19:2: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
PSA 19:3: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
PSA 19:4: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
PSA 19:5: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
PSA 19:6: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
PSA 19:7: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
PSA 19:8: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
PSA 19:9: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
PSA 19:10: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
PSA 19:11: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.
PSA 19:12: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
PSA 19:13: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
PSA 19:14: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
PSA 20:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
PSA 20:2: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
PSA 20:3: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
PSA 20:4: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
PSA 20:5: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
PSA 20:6: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
PSA 20:7: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
PSA 20:8: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
PSA 20:9: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
PSA 21:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
PSA 21:2: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
PSA 21:3: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
PSA 21:4: He asked You for life, and You granted it—length of days, forever and ever.
PSA 21:5: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
PSA 21:6: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
PSA 21:7: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
PSA 21:8: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
PSA 21:9: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
PSA 21:10: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
PSA 21:11: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
PSA 21:12: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
PSA 21:13: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
PSA 22:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
PSA 22:2: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
PSA 22:3: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
PSA 22:4: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
PSA 22:5: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
PSA 22:6: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
PSA 22:7: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
PSA 22:8: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
PSA 22:9: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.
PSA 22:10: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
PSA 22:11: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
PSA 22:12: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
PSA 22:13: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
PSA 22:14: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
PSA 22:15: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.
PSA 22:16: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
PSA 22:17: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
PSA 22:18: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
PSA 22:19: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
PSA 22:20: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
PSA 22:21: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!
PSA 22:22: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
PSA 22:23: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!
PSA 22:24: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
PSA 22:25: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
PSA 22:26: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
PSA 22:27: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
PSA 22:28: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.
PSA 22:29: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him—even those unable to preserve their lives.
PSA 22:30: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
PSA 22:31: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn—all that He has done.
PSA 23:1: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
PSA 23:2: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
PSA 23:3: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
PSA 23:4: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
PSA 23:5: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
PSA 23:6: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
PSA 24:1: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
PSA 24:2: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
PSA 24:3: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
PSA 24:4: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
PSA 24:5: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
PSA 24:6: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
PSA 24:7: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
PSA 24:8: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
PSA 24:9: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
PSA 24:10: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts—He is the King of Glory. Selah
PSA 25:1: Of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
PSA 25:2: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
PSA 25:3: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced.
PSA 25:4: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
PSA 25:5: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
PSA 25:6: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
PSA 25:7: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
PSA 25:8: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
PSA 25:9: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
PSA 25:10: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
PSA 25:11: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
PSA 25:12: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
PSA 25:13: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
PSA 25:14: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
PSA 25:15: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
PSA 25:16: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
PSA 25:17: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
PSA 25:18: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
PSA 25:19: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
PSA 25:20: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
PSA 25:21: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
PSA 25:22: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.
PSA 26:1: Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
PSA 26:2: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
PSA 26:3: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
PSA 26:4: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
PSA 26:5: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
PSA 26:6: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,
PSA 26:7: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.
PSA 26:8: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
PSA 26:9: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
PSA 26:10: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
PSA 26:11: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
PSA 26:12: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
PSA 27:1: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?
PSA 27:2: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
PSA 27:3: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
PSA 27:4: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
PSA 27:5: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
PSA 27:6: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
PSA 27:7: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
PSA 27:8: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
PSA 27:9: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
PSA 27:10: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
PSA 27:11: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
PSA 27:12: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
PSA 27:13: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
PSA 27:14: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
PSA 28:1: Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
PSA 28:2: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
PSA 28:3: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
PSA 28:4: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.
PSA 28:5: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
PSA 28:6: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.
PSA 28:7: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
PSA 28:8: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
PSA 28:9: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
PSA 29:1: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
PSA 29:2: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
PSA 29:3: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
PSA 29:4: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
PSA 29:5: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
PSA 29:6: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
PSA 29:7: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
PSA 29:8: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
PSA 29:9: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
PSA 29:10: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
PSA 29:11: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
PSA 30:1: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
PSA 30:2: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
PSA 30:3: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
PSA 30:4: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
PSA 30:5: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
PSA 30:6: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
PSA 30:7: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
PSA 30:8: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
PSA 30:9: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
PSA 30:10: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
PSA 30:11: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
PSA 30:12: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
PSA 31:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
PSA 31:2: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
PSA 31:3: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
PSA 31:4: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
PSA 31:5: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
PSA 31:6: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
PSA 31:7: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
PSA 31:8: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
PSA 31:9: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
PSA 31:10: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
PSA 31:11: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends—they flee when they see me on the street.
PSA 31:12: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
PSA 31:13: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
PSA 31:14: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
PSA 31:15: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
PSA 31:16: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
PSA 31:17: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
PSA 31:18: May lying lips be silenced—lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
PSA 31:19: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
PSA 31:20: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
PSA 31:21: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
PSA 31:22: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
PSA 31:23: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
PSA 31:24: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
PSA 32:1: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
PSA 32:2: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
PSA 32:3: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
PSA 32:4: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
PSA 32:5: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
PSA 32:6: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
PSA 32:7: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
PSA 32:8: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
PSA 32:9: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
PSA 32:10: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
PSA 32:11: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
PSA 33:1: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
PSA 33:2: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
PSA 33:3: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
PSA 33:4: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
PSA 33:5: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.
PSA 33:6: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
PSA 33:7: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
PSA 33:8: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
PSA 33:9: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
PSA 33:10: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
PSA 33:11: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
PSA 33:12: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
PSA 33:13: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
PSA 33:14: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.
PSA 33:15: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.
PSA 33:16: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
PSA 33:17: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
PSA 33:18: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
PSA 33:19: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
PSA 33:20: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
PSA 33:21: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
PSA 33:22: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
PSA 34:1: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
PSA 34:2: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
PSA 34:3: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
PSA 34:4: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
PSA 34:5: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
PSA 34:6: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
PSA 34:7: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
PSA 34:8: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
PSA 34:9: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
PSA 34:10: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
PSA 34:11: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
PSA 34:12: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
PSA 34:13: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
PSA 34:14: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
PSA 34:15: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
PSA 34:16: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
PSA 34:17: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
PSA 34:18: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
PSA 34:19: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
PSA 34:20: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
PSA 34:21: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
PSA 34:22: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
PSA 35:1: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.
PSA 35:2: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
PSA 35:3: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
PSA 35:4: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
PSA 35:5: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
PSA 35:6: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.
PSA 35:7: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
PSA 35:8: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
PSA 35:9: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
PSA 35:10: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
PSA 35:11: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
PSA 35:12: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
PSA 35:13: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
PSA 35:14: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
PSA 35:15: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
PSA 35:16: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
PSA 35:17: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
PSA 35:18: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
PSA 35:19: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
PSA 35:20: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
PSA 35:21: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
PSA 35:22: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
PSA 35:23: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
PSA 35:24: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
PSA 35:25: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
PSA 35:26: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
PSA 35:27: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
PSA 35:28: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
PSA 36:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
PSA 36:2: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
PSA 36:3: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
PSA 36:4: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
PSA 36:5: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
PSA 36:6: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
PSA 36:7: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
PSA 36:8: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
PSA 36:9: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
PSA 36:10: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
PSA 36:11: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
PSA 36:12: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
PSA 37:1: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
PSA 37:2: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
PSA 37:3: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
PSA 37:4: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
PSA 37:5: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
PSA 37:6: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
PSA 37:7: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
PSA 37:8: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.
PSA 37:9: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
PSA 37:10: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
PSA 37:11: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
PSA 37:12: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
PSA 37:13: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
PSA 37:14: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
PSA 37:15: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
PSA 37:16: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
PSA 37:17: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
PSA 37:18: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
PSA 37:19: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
PSA 37:20: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
PSA 37:21: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
PSA 37:22: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
PSA 37:23: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
PSA 37:24: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
PSA 37:25: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
PSA 37:26: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
PSA 37:27: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
PSA 37:28: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
PSA 37:29: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
PSA 37:30: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
PSA 37:31: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
PSA 37:32: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,
PSA 37:33: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
PSA 37:34: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
PSA 37:35: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
PSA 37:36: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
PSA 37:37: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
PSA 37:38: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
PSA 37:39: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
PSA 37:40: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.
PSA 38:1: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
PSA 38:2: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
PSA 38:3: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
PSA 38:4: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
PSA 38:5: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.
PSA 38:6: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
PSA 38:7: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
PSA 38:8: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
PSA 38:9: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
PSA 38:10: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
PSA 38:11: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
PSA 38:12: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
PSA 38:13: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
PSA 38:14: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
PSA 38:15: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
PSA 38:16: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me—those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
PSA 38:17: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
PSA 38:18: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
PSA 38:19: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
PSA 38:20: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
PSA 38:21: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
PSA 38:22: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
PSA 39:1: For the choirmaster. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”
PSA 39:2: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.
PSA 39:3: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
PSA 39:4: “Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.
PSA 39:5: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
PSA 39:6: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.
PSA 39:7: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
PSA 39:8: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.
PSA 39:9: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.
PSA 39:10: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
PSA 39:11: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah
PSA 39:12: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.
PSA 39:13: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”
PSA 40:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
PSA 40:2: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
PSA 40:3: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
PSA 40:4: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
PSA 40:5: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us—none can compare to You—if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
PSA 40:6: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
PSA 40:7: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come—it is written about me in the scroll:
PSA 40:8: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
PSA 40:9: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.
PSA 40:10: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
PSA 40:11: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
PSA 40:12: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.
PSA 40:13: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
PSA 40:14: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
PSA 40:15: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
PSA 40:16: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
PSA 40:17: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
PSA 41:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
PSA 41:2: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to give him over to the will of his foes.
PSA 41:3: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
PSA 41:4: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
PSA 41:5: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
PSA 41:6: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
PSA 41:7: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:
PSA 41:8: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
PSA 41:9: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
PSA 41:10: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
PSA 41:11: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
PSA 41:12: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
PSA 41:13: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
PSA 42:1: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
PSA 42:2: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
PSA 42:3: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
PSA 42:4: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the festive procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.
PSA 42:5: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
PSA 42:6: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon—even from Mount Mizar.
PSA 42:7: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
PSA 42:8: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
PSA 42:9: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
PSA 42:10: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
PSA 42:11: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
PSA 43:1: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
PSA 43:2: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
PSA 43:3: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
PSA 43:4: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
PSA 43:5: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
PSA 44:1: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
PSA 44:2: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
PSA 44:3: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
PSA 44:4: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
PSA 44:5: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
PSA 44:6: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
PSA 44:7: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
PSA 44:8: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
PSA 44:9: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
PSA 44:10: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
PSA 44:11: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
PSA 44:12: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.
PSA 44:13: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
PSA 44:14: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
PSA 44:15: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
PSA 44:16: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
PSA 44:17: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.
PSA 44:18: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
PSA 44:19: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
PSA 44:20: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
PSA 44:21: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
PSA 44:22: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
PSA 44:23: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
PSA 44:24: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
PSA 44:25: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
PSA 44:26: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
PSA 45:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
PSA 45:2: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
PSA 45:3: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
PSA 45:4: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
PSA 45:5: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
PSA 45:6: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
PSA 45:7: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
PSA 45:8: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
PSA 45:9: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.
PSA 45:10: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,
PSA 45:11: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.
PSA 45:12: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
PSA 45:13: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
PSA 45:14: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.
PSA 45:15: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
PSA 45:16: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
PSA 45:17: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
PSA 46:1: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
PSA 46:2: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
PSA 46:3: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
PSA 46:4: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
PSA 46:5: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
PSA 46:6: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
PSA 46:7: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
PSA 46:8: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
PSA 46:9: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
PSA 46:10: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
PSA 46:11: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
PSA 47:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
PSA 47:2: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
PSA 47:3: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
PSA 47:4: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
PSA 47:5: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
PSA 47:6: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
PSA 47:7: For God is King of all the earth; sing to Him a psalm of praise.
PSA 47:8: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
PSA 47:9: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
PSA 48:1: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
PSA 48:2: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.
PSA 48:3: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
PSA 48:4: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.
PSA 48:5: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.
PSA 48:6: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
PSA 48:7: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.
PSA 48:8: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah
PSA 48:9: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
PSA 48:10: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
PSA 48:11: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
PSA 48:12: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,
PSA 48:13: consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.
PSA 48:14: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
PSA 49:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,
PSA 49:2: both low and high, rich and poor alike.
PSA 49:3: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.
PSA 49:4: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
PSA 49:5: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?
PSA 49:6: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.
PSA 49:7: No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.
PSA 49:8: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,
PSA 49:9: that he should live on forever and not see decay.
PSA 49:10: For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.
PSA 49:11: Their graves are their eternal homes—their dwellings for endless generations—even though their lands were their namesakes.
PSA 49:12: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
PSA 49:13: This is the fate of the foolish and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah
PSA 49:14: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.
PSA 49:15: But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah
PSA 49:16: Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.
PSA 49:17: For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.
PSA 49:18: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul—and men praise you when you prosper—
PSA 49:19: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of day.
PSA 49:20: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
PSA 50:1: A Psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
PSA 50:2: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
PSA 50:3: Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
PSA 50:4: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:
PSA 50:5: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
PSA 50:6: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
PSA 50:7: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
PSA 50:8: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.
PSA 50:9: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
PSA 50:10: for every beast of the forest is Mine—the cattle on a thousand hills.
PSA 50:11: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.
PSA 50:12: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.
PSA 50:13: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
PSA 50:14: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
PSA 50:15: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
PSA 50:16: To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips?
PSA 50:17: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.
PSA 50:18: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.
PSA 50:19: You unleash your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.
PSA 50:20: You sit and malign your brother; you slander your own mother’s son.
PSA 50:21: You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.
PSA 50:22: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
PSA 50:23: He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rightly orders his way, I will show the salvation of God.”
PSA 51:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
PSA 51:2: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
PSA 51:3: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
PSA 51:4: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
PSA 51:5: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
PSA 51:6: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
PSA 51:7: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
PSA 51:8: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
PSA 51:9: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
PSA 51:10: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
PSA 51:11: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.
PSA 51:12: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
PSA 51:13: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
PSA 51:14: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
PSA 51:15: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
PSA 51:16: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
PSA 51:17: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
PSA 51:18: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
PSA 51:19: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
PSA 52:1: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of David. After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.
PSA 52:2: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
PSA 52:3: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah
PSA 52:4: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.
PSA 52:5: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
PSA 52:6: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,
PSA 52:7: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
PSA 52:8: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
PSA 52:9: I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name—for it is good—in the presence of Your saints.
PSA 53:1: For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.
PSA 53:2: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
PSA 53:3: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
PSA 53:4: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
PSA 53:5: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.
PSA 53:6: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
PSA 54:1: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?” Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!
PSA 54:2: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
PSA 54:3: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life—men with no regard for God. Selah
PSA 54:4: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
PSA 54:5: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
PSA 54:6: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
PSA 54:7: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
PSA 55:1: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.
PSA 55:2: Attend to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and distraught
PSA 55:3: at the voice of the enemy, at the pressure of the wicked. For they bring down disaster upon me and resent me in their anger.
PSA 55:4: My heart pounds within me, and the terrors of death assail me.
PSA 55:5: Fear and trembling grip me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
PSA 55:6: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and find rest.
PSA 55:7: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah
PSA 55:8: I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”
PSA 55:9: O Lord, confuse and confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.
PSA 55:10: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.
PSA 55:11: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
PSA 55:12: For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.
PSA 55:13: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion and close friend.
PSA 55:14: We shared sweet fellowship together; we walked with the crowd into the house of God.
PSA 55:15: Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.
PSA 55:16: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
PSA 55:17: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
PSA 55:18: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
PSA 55:19: God will hear and humiliate them—the One enthroned for the ages—Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.
PSA 55:20: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
PSA 55:21: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
PSA 55:22: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
PSA 55:23: But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
PSA 56:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
PSA 56:2: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
PSA 56:3: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
PSA 56:4: In God, whose word I praise—in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
PSA 56:5: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
PSA 56:6: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
PSA 56:7: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
PSA 56:8: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle—are they not in Your book?
PSA 56:9: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.
PSA 56:10: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
PSA 56:11: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
PSA 56:12: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
PSA 56:13: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
PSA 57:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
PSA 57:2: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
PSA 57:3: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
PSA 57:4: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts—with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
PSA 57:5: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
PSA 57:6: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
PSA 57:7: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
PSA 57:8: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
PSA 57:9: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
PSA 57:10: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
PSA 57:11: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
PSA 58:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David. Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?
PSA 58:2: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.
PSA 58:3: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.
PSA 58:4: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,
PSA 58:5: refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell.
PSA 58:6: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.
PSA 58:7: May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.
PSA 58:8: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child, may they never see the sun.
PSA 58:9: Before your pots can feel the burning thorns—whether green or dry—He will sweep them away.
PSA 58:10: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
PSA 58:11: Then men will say, “There is surely a reward for the righteous! There is surely a God who judges the earth!”
PSA 59:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
PSA 59:2: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
PSA 59:3: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
PSA 59:4: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.
PSA 59:5: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
PSA 59:6: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
