PSA 59:7: See what they spew from their mouths—sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
PSA 59:8: But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
PSA 59:9: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
PSA 59:10: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
PSA 59:11: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
PSA 59:12: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
PSA 59:13: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
PSA 59:14: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
PSA 59:15: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
PSA 59:16: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
PSA 59:17: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
PSA 60:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A Miktam of David for instruction. When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
PSA 60:2: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.
PSA 60:3: You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.
PSA 60:4: You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah
PSA 60:5: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
PSA 60:6: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
PSA 60:7: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
PSA 60:8: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
PSA 60:9: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
PSA 60:10: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
PSA 60:11: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
PSA 60:12: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
PSA 61:1: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
PSA 61:2: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
PSA 61:3: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
PSA 61:4: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
PSA 61:5: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
PSA 61:6: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
PSA 61:7: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.
PSA 61:8: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
PSA 62:1: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
PSA 62:2: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
PSA 62:3: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
PSA 62:4: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
PSA 62:5: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
PSA 62:6: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
PSA 62:7: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
PSA 62:8: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
PSA 62:9: Lowborn men are but a vapor; the exalted are but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
PSA 62:10: Place no trust in extortion or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
PSA 62:11: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
PSA 62:12: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
PSA 63:1: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
PSA 63:2: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
PSA 63:3: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
PSA 63:4: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
PSA 63:5: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
PSA 63:6: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
PSA 63:7: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
PSA 63:8: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
PSA 63:9: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.
PSA 63:10: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.
PSA 63:11: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
PSA 64:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
PSA 64:2: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,
PSA 64:3: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
PSA 64:4: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.
PSA 64:5: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.
PSA 64:6: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.
PSA 64:7: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
PSA 64:8: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.
PSA 64:9: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
PSA 64:10: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
PSA 65:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
PSA 65:2: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
PSA 65:3: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
PSA 65:4: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
PSA 65:5: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
PSA 65:6: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
PSA 65:7: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
PSA 65:8: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
PSA 65:9: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
PSA 65:10: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
PSA 65:11: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
PSA 65:12: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
PSA 65:13: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
PSA 66:1: For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!
PSA 66:2: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
PSA 66:3: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
PSA 66:4: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah
PSA 66:5: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
PSA 66:6: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.
PSA 66:7: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
PSA 66:8: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
PSA 66:9: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.
PSA 66:10: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
PSA 66:11: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
PSA 66:12: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.
PSA 66:13: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
PSA 66:14: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.
PSA 66:15: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah
PSA 66:16: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
PSA 66:17: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
PSA 66:18: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
PSA 66:19: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
PSA 66:20: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!
PSA 67:1: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
PSA 67:2: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
PSA 67:3: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
PSA 67:4: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
PSA 67:5: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
PSA 67:6: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
PSA 67:7: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
PSA 68:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.
PSA 68:2: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
PSA 68:3: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
PSA 68:4: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds—His name is the LORD—and rejoice before Him.
PSA 68:5: A father of the fatherless and a defender of widows is God in His holy habitation.
PSA 68:6: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
PSA 68:7: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
PSA 68:8: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
PSA 68:9: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
PSA 68:10: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
PSA 68:11: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
PSA 68:12: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.
PSA 68:13: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
PSA 68:14: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
PSA 68:15: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
PSA 68:16: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
PSA 68:17: The chariots of God are tens of thousands—thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.
PSA 68:18: You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.
PSA 68:19: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
PSA 68:20: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
PSA 68:21: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
PSA 68:22: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,
PSA 68:23: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes—the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
PSA 68:24: They have seen Your procession, O God—the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
PSA 68:25: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
PSA 68:26: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
PSA 68:27: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
PSA 68:28: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
PSA 68:29: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
PSA 68:30: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
PSA 68:31: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
PSA 68:32: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord—Selah
PSA 68:33: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
PSA 68:34: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.
PSA 68:35: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
PSA 69:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
PSA 69:2: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
PSA 69:3: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
PSA 69:4: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me—my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
PSA 69:5: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
PSA 69:6: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
PSA 69:7: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
PSA 69:8: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
PSA 69:9: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
PSA 69:10: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
PSA 69:11: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
PSA 69:12: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
PSA 69:13: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
PSA 69:14: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
PSA 69:15: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
PSA 69:16: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
PSA 69:17: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
PSA 69:18: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
PSA 69:19: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
PSA 69:20: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
PSA 69:21: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
PSA 69:22: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.
PSA 69:23: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
PSA 69:24: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.
PSA 69:25: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
PSA 69:26: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
PSA 69:27: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
PSA 69:28: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.
PSA 69:29: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.
PSA 69:30: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
PSA 69:31: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
PSA 69:32: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
PSA 69:33: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
PSA 69:34: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
PSA 69:35: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
PSA 69:36: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
PSA 70:1: For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
PSA 70:2: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
PSA 70:3: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
PSA 70:4: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
PSA 70:5: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
PSA 71:1: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
PSA 71:2: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
PSA 71:3: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
PSA 71:4: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
PSA 71:5: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
PSA 71:6: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
PSA 71:7: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
PSA 71:8: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
PSA 71:9: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
PSA 71:10: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,
PSA 71:11: saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”
PSA 71:12: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
PSA 71:13: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
PSA 71:14: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
PSA 71:15: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
PSA 71:16: I will come in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
PSA 71:17: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
PSA 71:18: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
PSA 71:19: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
PSA 71:20: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
PSA 71:21: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
PSA 71:22: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
PSA 71:23: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
PSA 71:24: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
PSA 72:1: Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
PSA 72:2: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
PSA 72:3: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
PSA 72:4: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
PSA 72:5: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.
PSA 72:6: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
PSA 72:7: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound until the moon is no more.
PSA 72:8: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
PSA 72:9: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
PSA 72:10: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
PSA 72:11: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
PSA 72:12: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
PSA 72:13: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
PSA 72:14: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
PSA 72:15: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
PSA 72:16: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, the people of its cities like the grass of the field.
PSA 72:17: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
PSA 72:18: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
PSA 72:19: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
PSA 72:20: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
PSA 73:1: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
PSA 73:2: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
PSA 73:3: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
PSA 73:4: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.
PSA 73:5: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.
PSA 73:6: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
PSA 73:7: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.
PSA 73:8: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
PSA 73:9: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.
PSA 73:10: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.
PSA 73:11: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
PSA 73:12: Behold, these are the wicked—always carefree as they increase their wealth.
PSA 73:13: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
PSA 73:14: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
PSA 73:15: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
PSA 73:16: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight
PSA 73:17: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.
PSA 73:18: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
PSA 73:19: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!
PSA 73:20: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
PSA 73:21: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
PSA 73:22: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
PSA 73:23: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
PSA 73:24: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
PSA 73:25: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
PSA 73:26: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
PSA 73:27: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
PSA 73:28: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
PSA 74:1: A Maskil of Asaph. Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
PSA 74:2: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance—Mount Zion, where You dwell.
PSA 74:3: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
PSA 74:4: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,
PSA 74:5: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
PSA 74:6: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
PSA 74:7: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
PSA 74:8: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
PSA 74:9: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.
PSA 74:10: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
PSA 74:11: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!
PSA 74:12: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
PSA 74:13: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
PSA 74:14: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
PSA 74:15: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
PSA 74:16: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
PSA 74:17: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
PSA 74:18: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
PSA 74:19: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
PSA 74:20: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
PSA 74:21: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
PSA 74:22: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
PSA 74:23: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
PSA 75:1: For the choirmaster: To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm of Asaph. A song. We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.
PSA 75:2: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
PSA 75:3: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah
PSA 75:4: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.
PSA 75:5: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
PSA 75:6: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,
PSA 75:7: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
PSA 75:8: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.
PSA 75:9: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
PSA 75:10: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
PSA 76:1: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A song. God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
PSA 76:2: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
PSA 76:3: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah
PSA 76:4: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
PSA 76:5: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
PSA 76:6: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
PSA 76:7: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
PSA 76:8: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
PSA 76:9: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
PSA 76:10: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
PSA 76:11: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
PSA 76:12: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
PSA 77:1: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
PSA 77:2: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
PSA 77:3: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
PSA 77:4: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
PSA 77:5: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
PSA 77:6: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
PSA 77:7: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
PSA 77:8: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
PSA 77:9: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
PSA 77:10: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
PSA 77:11: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
PSA 77:12: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
PSA 77:13: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
PSA 77:14: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
PSA 77:15: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
PSA 77:16: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
PSA 77:17: The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.
PSA 77:18: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
PSA 77:19: Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
PSA 77:20: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
PSA 78:1: A Maskil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.
PSA 78:2: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,
PSA 78:3: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
PSA 78:4: We will not hide them from their children but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might and the wonders He has performed.
PSA 78:5: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children,
PSA 78:6: that the coming generation would know them—even children yet to be born—to arise and tell their own children
PSA 78:7: that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.
PSA 78:8: Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
PSA 78:9: The archers of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle.
PSA 78:10: They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law.
PSA 78:11: They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.
PSA 78:12: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
PSA 78:13: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
PSA 78:14: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night.
PSA 78:15: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.
PSA 78:16: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers.
PSA 78:17: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
PSA 78:18: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.
PSA 78:19: They spoke against God, saying, “Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness?
PSA 78:20: When He struck the rock, water gushed out and torrents raged. But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat?”
PSA 78:21: Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and His anger flared against Israel,
PSA 78:22: because they did not believe God or rely on His salvation.
PSA 78:23: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens.
PSA 78:24: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
PSA 78:25: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.
PSA 78:26: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.
PSA 78:27: He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.
PSA 78:28: He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.
PSA 78:29: So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.
PSA 78:30: Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,
PSA 78:31: God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.
PSA 78:32: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.
PSA 78:33: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
PSA 78:34: When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.
PSA 78:35: And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
PSA 78:36: But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.
PSA 78:37: Their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant.
PSA 78:38: And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.
PSA 78:39: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
PSA 78:40: How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert!
PSA 78:41: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
PSA 78:42: They did not remember His power—the day He redeemed them from the adversary,
PSA 78:43: when He performed His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.
PSA 78:44: He turned their rivers to blood, and from their streams they could not drink.
PSA 78:45: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
PSA 78:46: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, the fruit of their labor to the locust.
PSA 78:47: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
PSA 78:48: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning.
PSA 78:49: He unleashed His fury against them, wrath, indignation, and calamity—a band of destroying angels.
PSA 78:50: He cleared a path for His anger; He did not spare them from death but delivered their lives to the plague.
PSA 78:51: He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, the virility in the tents of Ham.
PSA 78:52: He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
PSA 78:53: He led them safely, so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies.
PSA 78:54: He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired.
PSA 78:55: He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance; He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
PSA 78:56: But they tested and disobeyed God Most High, for they did not keep His decrees.
PSA 78:57: They turned back and were faithless like their fathers, twisted like a faulty bow.
PSA 78:58: They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols.
PSA 78:59: On hearing it, God was furious and rejected Israel completely.
PSA 78:60: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent He had pitched among men.
PSA 78:61: He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
PSA 78:62: He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage.
PSA 78:63: Fire consumed His young men, and their maidens were left without wedding songs.
PSA 78:64: His priests fell by the sword, but their widows could not lament.
PSA 78:65: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
PSA 78:66: He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.
PSA 78:67: He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused the tribe of Ephraim.
PSA 78:68: But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
PSA 78:69: He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He has established forever.
PSA 78:70: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
PSA 78:71: from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance.
PSA 78:72: So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands.
PSA 79:1: A Psalm of Asaph. The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
PSA 79:2: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
PSA 79:3: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
PSA 79:4: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
PSA 79:5: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
PSA 79:6: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,
PSA 79:7: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
PSA 79:8: Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.
PSA 79:9: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
PSA 79:10: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
PSA 79:11: May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
PSA 79:12: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
PSA 79:13: Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
PSA 80:1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm of Asaph. Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
PSA 80:2: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Rally Your mighty power and come to save us.
PSA 80:3: Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
PSA 80:4: O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?
PSA 80:5: You fed them with the bread of tears and made them drink the full measure of their tears.
PSA 80:6: You make us contend with our neighbors; our enemies mock us.
PSA 80:7: Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
PSA 80:8: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.
PSA 80:9: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
PSA 80:10: The mountains were covered by its shade, and the mighty cedars with its branches.
PSA 80:11: It sent out its branches to the Sea, and its shoots toward the River.
PSA 80:12: Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?
PSA 80:13: The boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed upon it.
PSA 80:14: Return, O God of Hosts, we pray! Look down from heaven and see! Attend to this vine—
PSA 80:15: the root Your right hand has planted, the son You have raised up for Yourself.
PSA 80:16: Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
PSA 80:17: Let Your hand be upon the man at Your right hand, on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself.
PSA 80:18: Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.
PSA 80:19: Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
PSA 81:1: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. Of Asaph. Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
PSA 81:2: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
PSA 81:3: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.
PSA 81:4: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
PSA 81:5: He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt, where I heard an unfamiliar language:
PSA 81:6: “I relieved his shoulder of the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.
PSA 81:7: You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
PSA 81:8: Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
PSA 81:9: There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god.
PSA 81:10: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.
PSA 81:11: But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.
PSA 81:12: So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
PSA 81:13: If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,
PSA 81:14: how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes!
PSA 81:15: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.
PSA 81:16: But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”
PSA 82:1: A Psalm of Asaph. God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:
PSA 82:2: “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah
PSA 82:3: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
PSA 82:4: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.
PSA 82:5: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
PSA 82:6: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
PSA 82:7: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”
PSA 82:8: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.
PSA 83:1: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.
PSA 83:2: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.
PSA 83:3: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
PSA 83:4: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
PSA 83:5: For with one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against You—
PSA 83:6: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
PSA 83:7: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.
PSA 83:8: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah
PSA 83:9: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
PSA 83:10: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
PSA 83:11: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
PSA 83:12: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”
PSA 83:13: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
PSA 83:14: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
PSA 83:15: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.
PSA 83:16: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
PSA 83:17: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.
PSA 83:18: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
PSA 84:1: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!
PSA 84:2: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
PSA 84:3: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.
PSA 84:4: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
PSA 84:5: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
PSA 84:6: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.
PSA 84:7: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
PSA 84:8: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
PSA 84:9: Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.
PSA 84:10: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
PSA 84:11: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
PSA 84:12: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
PSA 85:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
PSA 85:2: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
PSA 85:3: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
PSA 85:4: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
PSA 85:5: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
PSA 85:6: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
PSA 85:7: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
PSA 85:8: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.
PSA 85:9: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
PSA 85:10: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
PSA 85:11: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
PSA 85:12: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
PSA 85:13: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
PSA 86:1: A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
PSA 86:2: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
PSA 86:3: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
PSA 86:4: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
PSA 86:5: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
PSA 86:6: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
PSA 86:7: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
PSA 86:8: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
PSA 86:9: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
PSA 86:10: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
PSA 86:11: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
PSA 86:12: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
PSA 86:13: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
PSA 86:14: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life; they have no regard for You.
PSA 86:15: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
PSA 86:16: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.
PSA 86:17: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
PSA 87:1: A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A song. He has founded His city on the holy mountains.
PSA 87:2: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
PSA 87:3: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah
PSA 87:4: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me—along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush—when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
PSA 87:5: And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”
PSA 87:6: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah
PSA 87:7: Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”
PSA 88:1: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.
PSA 88:2: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
PSA 88:3: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
PSA 88:4: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
PSA 88:5: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
PSA 88:6: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
PSA 88:7: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
PSA 88:8: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
PSA 88:9: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
PSA 88:10: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
PSA 88:11: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
PSA 88:12: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
PSA 88:13: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
PSA 88:14: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
PSA 88:15: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
PSA 88:16: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
PSA 88:17: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
PSA 88:18: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
PSA 89:1: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
PSA 89:2: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
PSA 89:3: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
PSA 89:4: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
PSA 89:5: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD—Your faithfulness as well—in the assembly of the holy ones.
PSA 89:6: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
PSA 89:7: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
PSA 89:8: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
PSA 89:9: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
PSA 89:10: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
PSA 89:11: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
PSA 89:12: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
PSA 89:13: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
PSA 89:14: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
PSA 89:15: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
PSA 89:16: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
PSA 89:17: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
PSA 89:18: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
PSA 89:19: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
PSA 89:20: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
PSA 89:21: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
PSA 89:22: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
PSA 89:23: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
PSA 89:24: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
PSA 89:25: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
PSA 89:26: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
PSA 89:27: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
PSA 89:28: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
PSA 89:29: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
PSA 89:30: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
PSA 89:31: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
PSA 89:32: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
PSA 89:33: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
PSA 89:34: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
PSA 89:35: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness—I will not lie to David—
PSA 89:36: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
PSA 89:37: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
PSA 89:38: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
PSA 89:39: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
PSA 89:40: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
PSA 89:41: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
PSA 89:42: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
PSA 89:43: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
PSA 89:44: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
PSA 89:45: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
PSA 89:46: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
PSA 89:47: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
PSA 89:48: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
PSA 89:49: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
PSA 89:50: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
PSA 89:51: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
PSA 89:52: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
PSA 90:1: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
PSA 90:2: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
PSA 90:3: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”
PSA 90:4: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.
PSA 90:5: You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
PSA 90:6: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.
PSA 90:7: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
PSA 90:8: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
PSA 90:9: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
PSA 90:10: The length of our days is seventy years—or eighty if we are strong—yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
PSA 90:11: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
PSA 90:12: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
PSA 90:13: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
PSA 90:14: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
PSA 90:15: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
PSA 90:16: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
PSA 90:17: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands—yes, establish the work of our hands!
PSA 91:1: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
PSA 91:2: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
PSA 91:3: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
PSA 91:4: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
PSA 91:5: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
PSA 91:6: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
PSA 91:7: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
PSA 91:8: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
PSA 91:9: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling—my refuge, the Most High—
PSA 91:10: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
PSA 91:11: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
PSA 91:12: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
PSA 91:13: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
PSA 91:14: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
PSA 91:15: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
PSA 91:16: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
PSA 92:1: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
PSA 92:2: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
PSA 92:3: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
PSA 92:4: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
PSA 92:5: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
PSA 92:6: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,
PSA 92:7: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
PSA 92:8: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
PSA 92:9: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
PSA 92:10: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
PSA 92:11: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
PSA 92:12: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
PSA 92:13: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
PSA 92:14: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
PSA 92:15: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
PSA 93:1: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
PSA 93:2: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
PSA 93:3: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
PSA 93:4: Above the roar of many waters—the mighty breakers of the sea—the LORD on high is majestic.
PSA 93:5: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
PSA 94:1: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
PSA 94:2: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
PSA 94:3: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
PSA 94:4: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
PSA 94:5: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.
PSA 94:6: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
PSA 94:7: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
PSA 94:8: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?
PSA 94:9: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?
PSA 94:10: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?
PSA 94:11: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
PSA 94:12: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
PSA 94:13: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
PSA 94:14: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.
PSA 94:15: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
PSA 94:16: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?
PSA 94:17: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
PSA 94:18: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
PSA 94:19: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
PSA 94:20: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally—one devising mischief by decree?
PSA 94:21: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
PSA 94:22: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
PSA 94:23: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
PSA 95:1: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
PSA 95:2: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
PSA 95:3: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
PSA 95:4: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
PSA 95:5: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
PSA 95:6: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
PSA 95:7: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,
PSA 95:8: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness,
PSA 95:9: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
PSA 95:10: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”
PSA 95:11: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
PSA 96:1: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
PSA 96:2: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.
PSA 96:3: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
PSA 96:4: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
PSA 96:5: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
PSA 96:6: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
PSA 96:7: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
PSA 96:8: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
PSA 96:9: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
PSA 96:10: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
PSA 96:11: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
PSA 96:12: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
PSA 96:13: before the LORD, for He is coming—He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
PSA 97:1: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
PSA 97:2: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
PSA 97:3: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
PSA 97:4: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
PSA 97:5: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
PSA 97:6: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
PSA 97:7: All worshipers of images are put to shame—those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
PSA 97:8: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
PSA 97:9: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
PSA 97:10: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
PSA 97:11: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
PSA 97:12: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
PSA 98:1: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
PSA 98:2: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
PSA 98:3: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
PSA 98:4: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
PSA 98:5: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
PSA 98:6: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
PSA 98:7: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
PSA 98:8: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy
PSA 98:9: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
PSA 99:1: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
PSA 99:2: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
PSA 99:3: Let them praise Your great and awesome name—He is holy!
PSA 99:4: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
PSA 99:5: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
PSA 99:6: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.
PSA 99:7: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
PSA 99:8: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
PSA 99:9: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
PSA 100:1: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
PSA 100:2: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
PSA 100:3: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
PSA 100:4: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
PSA 100:5: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
PSA 101:1: A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
PSA 101:2: I will ponder the way that is blameless—when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
PSA 101:3: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
PSA 101:4: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
PSA 101:5: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
PSA 101:6: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
PSA 101:7: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
PSA 101:8: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
PSA 102:1: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
PSA 102:2: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
PSA 102:3: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
PSA 102:4: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
PSA 102:5: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.
PSA 102:6: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
PSA 102:7: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
PSA 102:8: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
PSA 102:9: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
PSA 102:10: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
PSA 102:11: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
PSA 102:12: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
PSA 102:13: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor—the appointed time has come.
PSA 102:14: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
PSA 102:15: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
PSA 102:16: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
PSA 102:17: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
PSA 102:18: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
PSA 102:19: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
PSA 102:20: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,
PSA 102:21: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,
PSA 102:22: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.
PSA 102:23: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.
PSA 102:24: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
PSA 102:25: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
PSA 102:26: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
PSA 102:27: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
PSA 102:28: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
PSA 103:1: Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
PSA 103:2: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
PSA 103:3: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
PSA 103:4: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
PSA 103:5: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
PSA 103:6: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
PSA 103:7: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
PSA 103:8: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
PSA 103:9: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
PSA 103:10: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
PSA 103:11: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
PSA 103:12: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
PSA 103:13: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
PSA 103:14: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
PSA 103:15: As for man, his days are like grass—he blooms like a flower of the field;
PSA 103:16: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
PSA 103:17: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
PSA 103:18: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
PSA 103:19: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
PSA 103:20: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
PSA 103:21: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.
PSA 103:22: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
PSA 104:1: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
PSA 104:2: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
PSA 104:3: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
PSA 104:4: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
PSA 104:5: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
PSA 104:6: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
PSA 104:7: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
PSA 104:8: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
PSA 104:9: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
PSA 104:10: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
PSA 104:11: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
PSA 104:12: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
PSA 104:13: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
PSA 104:14: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
PSA 104:15: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
PSA 104:16: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
PSA 104:17: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
PSA 104:18: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
PSA 104:19: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
PSA 104:20: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
PSA 104:21: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
PSA 104:22: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
PSA 104:23: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
PSA 104:24: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
PSA 104:25: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
PSA 104:26: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
PSA 104:27: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
PSA 104:28: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
PSA 104:29: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
PSA 104:30: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
PSA 104:31: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
PSA 104:32: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
PSA 104:33: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
PSA 104:34: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
PSA 104:35: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
PSA 105:1: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
PSA 105:2: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
PSA 105:3: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
PSA 105:4: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
PSA 105:5: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
PSA 105:6: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
PSA 105:7: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
PSA 105:8: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
