PSA 105:9: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
PSA 105:10: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
PSA 105:11: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
PSA 105:12: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
PSA 105:13: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
PSA 105:14: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
PSA 105:15: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
PSA 105:16: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
PSA 105:17: He sent a man before them—Joseph, sold as a slave.
PSA 105:18: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
PSA 105:19: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
PSA 105:20: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
PSA 105:21: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
PSA 105:22: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
PSA 105:23: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
PSA 105:24: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
PSA 105:25: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
PSA 105:26: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
PSA 105:27: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
PSA 105:28: He sent darkness, and it became dark—yet they defied His words.
PSA 105:29: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
PSA 105:30: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
PSA 105:31: He spoke, and insects swarmed—gnats throughout their country.
PSA 105:32: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
PSA 105:33: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
PSA 105:34: He spoke, and the locusts came—young locusts without number.
PSA 105:35: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
PSA 105:36: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
PSA 105:37: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
PSA 105:38: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
PSA 105:39: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
PSA 105:40: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
PSA 105:41: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
PSA 105:42: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
PSA 105:43: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
PSA 105:44: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
PSA 105:45: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
PSA 106:1: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 106:2: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
PSA 106:3: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
PSA 106:4: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
PSA 106:5: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
PSA 106:6: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
PSA 106:7: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
PSA 106:8: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
PSA 106:9: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
PSA 106:10: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
PSA 106:11: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
PSA 106:12: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
PSA 106:13: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
PSA 106:14: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
PSA 106:15: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
PSA 106:16: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
PSA 106:17: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
PSA 106:18: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
PSA 106:19: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
PSA 106:20: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
PSA 106:21: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
PSA 106:22: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
PSA 106:23: So He said He would destroy them—had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
PSA 106:24: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
PSA 106:25: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
PSA 106:26: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
PSA 106:27: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
PSA 106:28: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
PSA 106:29: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
PSA 106:30: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
PSA 106:31: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
PSA 106:32: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
PSA 106:33: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
PSA 106:34: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
PSA 106:35: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
PSA 106:36: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
PSA 106:37: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
PSA 106:38: They shed innocent blood—the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
PSA 106:39: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
PSA 106:40: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
PSA 106:41: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
PSA 106:42: Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.
PSA 106:43: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
PSA 106:44: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
PSA 106:45: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
PSA 106:46: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
PSA 106:47: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
PSA 106:48: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
PSA 107:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 107:2: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
PSA 107:3: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
PSA 107:4: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
PSA 107:5: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
PSA 107:6: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
PSA 107:7: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
PSA 107:8: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
PSA 107:9: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
PSA 107:10: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
PSA 107:11: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
PSA 107:12: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
PSA 107:13: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
PSA 107:14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
PSA 107:15: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
PSA 107:16: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
PSA 107:17: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
PSA 107:18: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
PSA 107:19: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
PSA 107:20: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
PSA 107:21: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
PSA 107:22: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
PSA 107:23: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
PSA 107:24: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
PSA 107:25: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
PSA 107:26: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
PSA 107:27: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
PSA 107:28: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
PSA 107:29: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
PSA 107:30: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
PSA 107:31: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
PSA 107:32: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
PSA 107:33: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
PSA 107:34: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
PSA 107:35: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
PSA 107:36: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
PSA 107:37: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
PSA 107:38: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
PSA 107:39: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
PSA 107:40: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
PSA 107:41: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
PSA 107:42: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
PSA 107:43: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
PSA 108:1: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
PSA 108:2: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
PSA 108:3: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
PSA 108:4: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
PSA 108:5: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
PSA 108:6: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
PSA 108:7: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
PSA 108:8: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
PSA 108:9: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
PSA 108:10: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
PSA 108:11: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
PSA 108:12: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
PSA 108:13: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
PSA 109:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent.
PSA 109:2: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
PSA 109:3: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
PSA 109:4: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
PSA 109:5: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
PSA 109:6: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
PSA 109:7: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
PSA 109:8: May his days be few; may another take his position.
PSA 109:9: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
PSA 109:10: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
PSA 109:11: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
PSA 109:12: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
PSA 109:13: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
PSA 109:14: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
PSA 109:15: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
PSA 109:16: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.
PSA 109:17: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
PSA 109:18: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
PSA 109:19: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
PSA 109:20: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
PSA 109:21: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
PSA 109:22: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
PSA 109:23: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
PSA 109:24: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
PSA 109:25: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
PSA 109:26: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
PSA 109:27: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
PSA 109:28: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
PSA 109:29: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
PSA 109:30: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
PSA 109:31: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
PSA 110:1: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
PSA 110:2: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
PSA 110:3: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
PSA 110:4: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
PSA 110:5: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
PSA 110:6: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
PSA 110:7: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
PSA 111:1: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
PSA 111:2: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
PSA 111:3: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
PSA 111:4: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
PSA 111:5: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
PSA 111:6: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
PSA 111:7: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
PSA 111:8: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
PSA 111:9: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
PSA 111:10: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
PSA 112:1: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
PSA 112:2: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
PSA 112:3: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
PSA 112:4: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright—for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
PSA 112:5: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
PSA 112:6: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
PSA 112:7: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
PSA 112:8: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
PSA 112:9: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
PSA 112:10: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
PSA 113:1: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
PSA 113:2: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
PSA 113:3: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
PSA 113:4: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.
PSA 113:5: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
PSA 113:6: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
PSA 113:7: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
PSA 113:8: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
PSA 113:9: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
PSA 114:1: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
PSA 114:2: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel His dominion.
PSA 114:3: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
PSA 114:4: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
PSA 114:5: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
PSA 114:6: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
PSA 114:7: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
PSA 114:8: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
PSA 115:1: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
PSA 115:2: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
PSA 115:3: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
PSA 115:4: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
PSA 115:5: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
PSA 115:6: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
PSA 115:7: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
PSA 115:8: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
PSA 115:9: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
PSA 115:10: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
PSA 115:11: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
PSA 115:12: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
PSA 115:13: He will bless those who fear the LORD—small and great alike.
PSA 115:14: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
PSA 115:15: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
PSA 115:16: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
PSA 115:17: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
PSA 115:18: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!
PSA 116:1: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice—my appeal for mercy.
PSA 116:2: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
PSA 116:3: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
PSA 116:4: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
PSA 116:5: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
PSA 116:6: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
PSA 116:7: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
PSA 116:8: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
PSA 116:9: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
PSA 116:10: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
PSA 116:11: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
PSA 116:12: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
PSA 116:13: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
PSA 116:14: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
PSA 116:15: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
PSA 116:16: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
PSA 116:17: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
PSA 116:18: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
PSA 116:19: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
PSA 117:1: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
PSA 117:2: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
PSA 118:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 118:2: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
PSA 118:3: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
PSA 118:4: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
PSA 118:5: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
PSA 118:6: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
PSA 118:7: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
PSA 118:8: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
PSA 118:9: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
PSA 118:10: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
PSA 118:11: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
PSA 118:12: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
PSA 118:13: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
PSA 118:14: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
PSA 118:15: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
PSA 118:16: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
PSA 118:17: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
PSA 118:18: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
PSA 118:19: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
PSA 118:20: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
PSA 118:21: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
PSA 118:22: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
PSA 118:23: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
PSA 118:24: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
PSA 118:25: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
PSA 118:26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
PSA 118:27: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
PSA 118:28: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
PSA 118:29: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 119:1: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
PSA 119:2: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
PSA 119:3: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
PSA 119:4: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
PSA 119:5: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
PSA 119:6: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
PSA 119:7: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
PSA 119:8: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
PSA 119:9: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
PSA 119:10: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
PSA 119:11: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
PSA 119:12: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:13: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
PSA 119:14: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
PSA 119:15: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
PSA 119:16: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
PSA 119:17: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
PSA 119:18: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
PSA 119:19: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
PSA 119:20: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
PSA 119:21: You rebuke the arrogant—the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
PSA 119:22: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
PSA 119:23: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
PSA 119:24: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
PSA 119:25: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
PSA 119:26: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:27: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
PSA 119:28: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
PSA 119:29: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
PSA 119:30: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
PSA 119:31: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
PSA 119:32: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
PSA 119:33: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
PSA 119:34: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
PSA 119:35: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
PSA 119:36: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
PSA 119:37: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
PSA 119:38: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
PSA 119:39: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
PSA 119:40: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
PSA 119:41: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
PSA 119:42: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
PSA 119:43: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
PSA 119:44: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
PSA 119:45: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
PSA 119:46: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
PSA 119:47: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
PSA 119:48: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
PSA 119:49: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
PSA 119:50: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
PSA 119:51: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
PSA 119:52: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
PSA 119:53: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
PSA 119:54: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
PSA 119:55: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
PSA 119:56: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
PSA 119:57: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
PSA 119:58: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
PSA 119:59: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
PSA 119:60: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
PSA 119:61: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
PSA 119:62: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
PSA 119:63: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
PSA 119:64: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:65: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
PSA 119:66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
PSA 119:67: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
PSA 119:68: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:69: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
PSA 119:70: Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.
PSA 119:71: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
PSA 119:72: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
PSA 119:73: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
PSA 119:74: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
PSA 119:75: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
PSA 119:76: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
PSA 119:77: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
PSA 119:78: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
PSA 119:79: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
PSA 119:80: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
PSA 119:81: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
PSA 119:82: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
PSA 119:83: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
PSA 119:84: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
PSA 119:85: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
PSA 119:86: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
PSA 119:87: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
PSA 119:88: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
PSA 119:89: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
PSA 119:90: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
PSA 119:91: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
PSA 119:92: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
PSA 119:93: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
PSA 119:94: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
PSA 119:95: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
PSA 119:96: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
PSA 119:97: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
PSA 119:98: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
PSA 119:99: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
PSA 119:100: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
PSA 119:101: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
PSA 119:102: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
PSA 119:103: How sweet are Your words to my taste—sweeter than honey in my mouth!
PSA 119:104: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
PSA 119:105: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
PSA 119:106: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
PSA 119:107: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
PSA 119:108: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
PSA 119:109: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
PSA 119:110: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
PSA 119:111: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
PSA 119:112: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
PSA 119:113: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
PSA 119:114: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
PSA 119:115: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
PSA 119:116: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
PSA 119:117: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
PSA 119:118: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
PSA 119:119: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
PSA 119:120: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
PSA 119:121: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
PSA 119:122: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
PSA 119:123: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
PSA 119:124: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:125: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
PSA 119:126: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
PSA 119:127: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
PSA 119:128: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
PSA 119:129: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
PSA 119:130: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
PSA 119:131: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
PSA 119:132: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
PSA 119:133: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
PSA 119:134: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
PSA 119:135: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:136: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
PSA 119:137: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
PSA 119:138: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
PSA 119:139: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
PSA 119:140: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
PSA 119:141: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
PSA 119:142: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
PSA 119:143: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
PSA 119:144: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
PSA 119:145: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
PSA 119:146: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
PSA 119:147: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
PSA 119:148: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
PSA 119:149: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
PSA 119:150: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
PSA 119:151: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
PSA 119:152: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
PSA 119:153: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
PSA 119:154: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
PSA 119:155: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
PSA 119:156: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
PSA 119:157: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
PSA 119:158: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
PSA 119:159: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
PSA 119:160: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
PSA 119:161: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
PSA 119:162: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
PSA 119:163: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
PSA 119:164: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
PSA 119:165: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
PSA 119:166: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
PSA 119:167: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
PSA 119:168: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
PSA 119:169: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
PSA 119:170: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
PSA 119:171: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
PSA 119:172: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
PSA 119:173: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
PSA 119:174: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
PSA 119:175: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
PSA 119:176: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
PSA 120:1: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
PSA 120:2: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
PSA 120:3: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
PSA 120:4: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
PSA 120:5: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
PSA 120:6: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
PSA 120:7: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
PSA 121:1: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
PSA 121:2: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
PSA 121:3: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
PSA 121:4: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
PSA 121:5: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
PSA 121:6: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
PSA 121:7: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
PSA 121:8: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
PSA 122:1: A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
PSA 122:2: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
PSA 122:3: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
PSA 122:4: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
PSA 122:5: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
PSA 122:6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
PSA 122:7: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
PSA 122:8: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
PSA 122:9: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
PSA 123:1: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
PSA 123:2: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
PSA 123:3: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
PSA 123:4: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
PSA 124:1: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side—let Israel now declare—
PSA 124:2: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
PSA 124:3: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
PSA 124:4: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
PSA 124:5: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
PSA 124:6: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
PSA 124:7: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
PSA 124:8: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
PSA 125:1: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
PSA 125:2: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
PSA 125:3: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
PSA 125:4: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
PSA 125:5: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
PSA 126:1: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
PSA 126:2: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
PSA 126:3: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
PSA 126:4: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
PSA 126:5: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
PSA 126:6: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
PSA 127:1: A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
PSA 127:2: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat—for He gives sleep to His beloved.
PSA 127:3: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
PSA 127:4: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
PSA 127:5: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
PSA 128:1: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
PSA 128:2: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
PSA 128:3: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
PSA 128:4: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
PSA 128:5: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
PSA 128:6: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
PSA 129:1: A song of ascents. Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth—let Israel now declare—
PSA 129:2: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
PSA 129:3: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
PSA 129:4: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
PSA 129:5: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
PSA 129:6: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
PSA 129:7: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
PSA 129:8: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
PSA 130:1: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
PSA 130:2: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
PSA 130:3: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
PSA 130:4: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
PSA 130:5: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
PSA 130:6: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning—more than watchmen wait for the morning.
PSA 130:7: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
PSA 130:8: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
PSA 131:1: A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
PSA 131:2: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
PSA 131:3: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
PSA 132:1: A song of ascents. O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
PSA 132:2: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
PSA 132:3: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
PSA 132:4: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
PSA 132:5: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
PSA 132:6: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
PSA 132:7: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
PSA 132:8: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
PSA 132:9: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
PSA 132:10: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
PSA 132:11: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
PSA 132:12: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
PSA 132:13: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
PSA 132:14: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
PSA 132:15: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
PSA 132:16: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
PSA 132:17: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
PSA 132:18: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
PSA 133:1: A song of ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
PSA 133:2: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
PSA 133:3: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
PSA 134:1: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
PSA 134:2: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
PSA 134:3: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
PSA 135:1: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
PSA 135:2: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
PSA 135:3: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
PSA 135:4: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
PSA 135:5: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
PSA 135:6: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
PSA 135:7: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
PSA 135:8: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
PSA 135:9: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
PSA 135:10: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
PSA 135:11: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
PSA 135:12: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
PSA 135:13: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
PSA 135:14: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
PSA 135:15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
PSA 135:16: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
PSA 135:17: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
PSA 135:18: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
PSA 135:19: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
PSA 135:20: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
PSA 135:21: Blessed be the LORD from Zion—He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
PSA 136:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:2: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:3: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:4: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:5: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:6: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:7: He made the great lights—His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:8: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:9: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:10: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:11: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:12: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:13: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:14: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:15: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:16: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:17: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:18: and slaughtered mighty kings—His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:19: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:20: and Og king of Bashan—His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:21: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:22: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:23: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:24: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:25: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 136:26: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
PSA 137:1: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
PSA 137:2: There on the willows we hung our harps,
PSA 137:3: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”
PSA 137:4: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?
PSA 137:5: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.
PSA 137:6: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!
PSA 137:7: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
PSA 137:8: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
PSA 137:9: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
PSA 138:1: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
PSA 138:2: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
PSA 138:3: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
PSA 138:4: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
PSA 138:5: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
PSA 138:6: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
PSA 138:7: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
PSA 138:8: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever—do not abandon the works of Your hands.
PSA 139:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
PSA 139:2: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
PSA 139:3: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
PSA 139:4: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
PSA 139:5: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
PSA 139:6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
PSA 139:7: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
PSA 139:8: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
PSA 139:9: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
PSA 139:10: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
PSA 139:11: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
PSA 139:12: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
PSA 139:13: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
PSA 139:14: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
PSA 139:15: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
PSA 139:16: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
PSA 139:17: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
PSA 139:18: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
PSA 139:19: O God, that You would slay the wicked—away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
PSA 139:20: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
PSA 139:21: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
PSA 139:22: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
PSA 139:23: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
PSA 139:24: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
PSA 140:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
PSA 140:2: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
PSA 140:3: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
PSA 140:4: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
PSA 140:5: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
PSA 140:6: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
PSA 140:7: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
PSA 140:8: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
PSA 140:9: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
PSA 140:10: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
PSA 140:11: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
PSA 140:12: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
PSA 140:13: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
PSA 141:1: A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
PSA 141:2: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.
PSA 141:3: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
PSA 141:4: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
PSA 141:5: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
PSA 141:6: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.
PSA 141:7: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
PSA 141:8: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
PSA 141:9: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
PSA 141:10: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
PSA 142:1: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
PSA 142:2: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
PSA 142:3: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
PSA 142:4: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
PSA 142:5: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
PSA 142:6: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
PSA 142:7: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
PSA 143:1: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
PSA 143:2: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
PSA 143:3: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
PSA 143:4: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
PSA 143:5: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
PSA 143:6: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
PSA 143:7: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
PSA 143:8: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
PSA 143:9: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
PSA 143:10: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
PSA 143:11: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
PSA 143:12: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
PSA 144:1: Of David. Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
PSA 144:2: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
PSA 144:3: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
PSA 144:4: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
PSA 144:5: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
PSA 144:6: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
PSA 144:7: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
PSA 144:8: whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
PSA 144:9: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—
PSA 144:10: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
PSA 144:11: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
PSA 144:12: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
PSA 144:13: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.
PSA 144:14: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.
PSA 144:15: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
PSA 145:1: A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
PSA 145:2: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
PSA 145:3: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
PSA 145:4: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
PSA 145:5: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
PSA 145:6: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
PSA 145:7: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
PSA 145:8: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
PSA 145:9: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
PSA 145:10: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
PSA 145:11: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,
PSA 145:12: to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
PSA 145:13: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
PSA 145:14: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
PSA 145:15: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
PSA 145:16: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
PSA 145:17: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
PSA 145:18: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
PSA 145:19: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
PSA 145:20: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
PSA 145:21: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.
PSA 146:1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
PSA 146:2: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
PSA 146:3: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
PSA 146:4: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
PSA 146:5: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
PSA 146:6: the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.
PSA 146:7: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
PSA 146:8: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
PSA 146:9: The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
PSA 146:10: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
PSA 147:1: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
PSA 147:2: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
PSA 147:3: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
PSA 147:4: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
PSA 147:5: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
PSA 147:6: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
PSA 147:7: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,
PSA 147:8: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
PSA 147:9: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
PSA 147:10: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
PSA 147:11: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
PSA 147:12: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
PSA 147:13: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.
PSA 147:14: He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
PSA 147:15: He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
PSA 147:16: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
PSA 147:17: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
PSA 147:18: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
PSA 147:19: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
PSA 147:20: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!
PSA 148:1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
PSA 148:2: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
PSA 148:3: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
PSA 148:4: Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
PSA 148:5: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
PSA 148:6: He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
PSA 148:7: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
PSA 148:8: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
PSA 148:9: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
PSA 148:10: wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
PSA 148:11: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,
PSA 148:12: young men and maidens, old and young together.
PSA 148:13: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
PSA 148:14: He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
PSA 149:1: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song—His praise in the assembly of the godly.
PSA 149:2: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
PSA 149:3: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
PSA 149:4: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
PSA 149:5: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
PSA 149:6: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,
PSA 149:7: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
PSA 149:8: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron,
PSA 149:9: to execute the judgment written against them. This honor is for all His saints. Hallelujah!
PSA 150:1: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
PSA 150:2: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.
PSA 150:3: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
PSA 150:4: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
PSA 150:5: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
PSA 150:6: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
